We are water
experts.

Every project starts with a site investigation. Before we design anything, we study how water reaches the site, what it does there and where it goes.

Hydrology

How much water arrives, how often and how fast: rainfall, runoff and flood flows across the watershed.

Soil Mechanics

What the ground can hold: bank strength, slope stability and bearing capacity for the protection we build.

Geomorphology

How the channel has moved and where it is heading: migrating bends, lowering beds, advancing headcuts.

Hydraulics

What the water does at the site: depth, velocity, shear and scour against the bank, bed or structure.

Sedimentology

What the water carries and leaves behind, which decides whether a bank rebuilds or keeps eroding.

One team, from site investigation through construction.

Every Er-Con project runs through the same in-house teams. The work is not handed from a consultant to a supplier to a contractor, so the people who define the problem are the ones who solve it.

Site Investigation

Every project starts here. We study the site's hydrology, geomorphology, hydraulics and sedimentology, so our engineers can separate the visible symptom from the underlying problem.

Scoping & Root Cause

We find what's actually causing the damage and how far the work needs to go, then recommend the fix that fits the site.

Engineering & Drawings

Our engineers turn the investigation findings into an engineered design for the site, set out in construction drawings built for the field and made to last.

Permitting & Approvals

Permitting extends beyond environmental review to floodplain and other site-specific requirements. Er-Con prepares and submits applications, coordinates with agencies and sees every required permit through review and approval before work moves into the field.

Construction

Our own crews build it, managing safety and quality on site. If conditions on the ground turn out to be different from the drawings, the crew and our engineers work it out together.

Long-Term Protection

The result is a site-specific solution that addresses the forces behind the problem, stabilizes the ground and protects critical assets.
